title: 第11章 火老第12章 血火佣兵团
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
江尘由于修炼了吞天魔龙诀，功法的运转，无时无刻都在强化江尘的肉身。
江尘的肉身比同阶的修炼者强大太多了，这拔刀斩十分适合他修炼。
如果配合灭天一击秘术的话，本身实力五倍的威力，加上灭天一击十倍的强化，那么就是五十倍的加成。
这样的一刀斩出去，威力可想而知了，以江江现在的实力，拔刀斩与灭天一击同时施展的话，武师境中，也没有几人能挡得住吧？
除非对方是武宗境强者。
“就你了。”
江尘选了拔刀斩。
接下来，江尘还选了一门二阶掌法武技，焚焰掌，真气可以凝聚出火焰，给敌人带来爆发性的伤害。
还有一门二阶身法，飞浪步。
一门二阶刀法武技，大荒刀法。
大荒刀法，大开大合，是一门霸道的武技。
每一门二阶武技，价格二百灵石。
拔刀斩，焚焰掌，飞浪步，大荒刀法共四门，花费了江尘八百灵石。
“总共八百灵石。”
火老开口道。
江尘于是交了灵石，然后在一旁抄录起来，抄完之后，将武技原书还给火老。
“江尘，前段时间，听闻你修为被废了，看来是谣言啊。”
火老突然道。
江尘内心一紧，担心自己的秘密被人发现了。
吞天珠的秘密可不能让别人知晓，否则如此逆天的功法让人知晓了，容易招来杀身之祸。

江尘的丹田被吞天珠代替了，吞天珠就是江尘新的丹田。
“那是小子运气好，丹田没有破，所以修为还在。”
江尘道。
“嗯，你能逃过那一劫，说明你的气运不差，看来你喜欢用刀，我这儿有一门刀法武技，位列五阶，如果你能帮我完成一件事，我就将其传授给你如何？”
火老说道。
“五阶武技！
“江尘闻言，倒吸一口凉气。
五阶武技，在青月镇中绝对是属于传说中的存在。
眼前的火老居然有五阶武技。
要知道，明面上，三大家族最强的武技才是四阶，而且数量极少，也就两三门，被当作宝贝一样。
现在火老居然说他有一门五阶武技，让江尘如何不吃惊？
“小子实力有限，就算有五阶武技，也修炼不了。”
content_en:
Because Jiang Chen has practiced the Heaven-Swallowing Demonic Dragon Art, the operation of the technique is strengthening Jiang Chen's physical body all the time.
Jiang Chen's physical body is much stronger than that of cultivators of the same level, so this drawing sword attack is very suitable for his cultivation.
If combined with the secret technique of the Heaven-Destroying Strike, the power of five times the own strength and the ten-fold strengthening of the Heaven-Destroying Strike would be a fifty-fold bonus.
The power of such a sword slash can be imagined. With Jiang Jiang's current strength, if the sword slash and the sky-destroying strike are executed at the same time, there won't be many people in the martial arts realm who can stop it, right?
Unless the other party is a strong person in the Wuzong realm.
"It's just you."
Jiang Chen chose to draw his sword and kill.
Next, Jiang Chen also chose a second-level palm martial skill, Burning Flame Palm. The true energy can condense into flames, causing explosive damage to the enemy.
There is also a second level body technique, Flying Wave Step.
A second-level sword technique, Dahuang Sword Technique.
Dahuang Sword Technique, Dakai Dakai, is a domineering martial skill.
Each second-level martial skill costs two hundred spirit stones.
There are four sword techniques in total, namely Drawing Sword, Burning Flame Palm, Flying Wave Step, and Great Wilderness Sword Techniques, which cost Jiang Chen eight hundred spirit stones.
"A total of eight hundred spirit stones."
Huo Lao said.
Jiang Chen then handed over the spirit stone and copied it on the side. After copying, he returned the original martial arts book to Huo Lao.
"Jiang Chen, some time ago, I heard that your cultivation was abolished. It seems to be a rumor."
Huo Lao said suddenly.
Jiang Chen's heart tightened, worried that his secret would be discovered.
The secret of swallowing the Dzi Bead must not be known to others, otherwise if such a heaven-defying technique were known, it would easily lead to death.
Jiang Chen's Dantian was replaced by the Sky-Swallowing Pearl, and the Sky-Swallowing Pearl was Jiang Chen's new Dantian.
"That's because the boy is lucky. His Dantian is not broken, so his cultivation is still there."
Jiang Chen said.
"Well, the fact that you were able to escape that disaster shows that your luck is not bad. It seems that you like to use swords. I have a sword technique here, which is ranked fifth level. If you can help me complete one thing, how about I teach it to you?"
Huo Lao said.
"Fifth level martial arts!
"Jiang Chen took a deep breath when he heard this.
Fifth-level martial arts are definitely legendary in Qingyue Town.
The Huo Lao in front of him actually had fifth-level martial arts.
You know, on the surface, the strongest martial arts of the three major families are the fourth level, and the number is very small, only two or three, and they are treated like treasures.
Now Huo Lao actually said that he had a fifth-level martial skill. How could Jiang Chen not be surprised?
"The boy's strength is limited. Even if he has fifth-level martial arts, he can't practice it."
